en.title: Merge Two Sorted Arrays of Equal Length
en.description:
Merge two non-decreasing arrays, each of length n, and output all 2n elements, keeping duplicates.

The standard input/output format was compiled by this site; added numeric bounds and the encoding for no-solution cases are explicitly marked and do not claim to be the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, the second line contains array a, and the third line contains array b. Full original ranges: 2≤n≤100000, 0≤a[i],b[i]≤10^9, and both arrays are sorted.
en.output: Output the 2n integers in non-decreasing order.
hints: With two pointers, each time output the smaller unused head element; when one side runs out, append the other side.
